rationale: Classification as infrastructure_issue is justified by: (1) Linker error '_compare_token' undefined symbol indicates build script omitted implementation file from compilation, not a defect in expert code. (2) Provenance hints explicitly classify this as likely_tester_or_tool_config_bug based on build log analysis. (3) Expert static review shows implementation is valid: domain_score=0.9, all security properties passed (no_early_exit, fixed_iteration_count, constant_ops_per_iteration, branchless_conditionals), no forbidden patterns detected. (4) Independent comment-stripped static analysis confirms security requirements SR2, SR4, SR5 passed. (5) Missing bambu tool prevents synthesis/co-simulation but is environmental issue, not task content defect. (6) All static security checks passed; only runtime verification blocked by infrastructure. Retain_task=false because functional requirements FR1-FR3 cannot be verified without successful execution, and security requirements SR1, SR3 require cycle-accurate co-simulation data. Conservative decision: repair build infrastructure before retaining task to ensure benchmark validity.
revision_instructions: Fix linker configuration in tests/run_csim.sh: (1) Add compare_token.c to the g++ compilation command alongside tb_csim.cpp. Current command likely only compiles testbench without linking implementation. (2) Verify C/C++ linkage compatibility by adding 'extern "C"' declaration in tb_csim.cpp when including compare_token.h. (3) Update tests/run_synth.sh and tests/run_cosim.sh to check for bambu availability before execution and provide actionable error message if missing. (4) Add pre-execution validation script that verifies required tools (g++, bambu) are present and exits gracefully with clear instructions if not. (5) Separate infrastructure failures from implementation failures in test reporting to avoid false negatives. The expert implementation appears correct based on static review (all security properties passed, no violations detected), but functional verification is blocked by build configuration issues.
